data.title: Family Sponsorship
data.subtitle: Reunite with your loved ones in Canada through the family sponsorship program—with expert support every step of the way.
data.intro_title: Bring Your Family Home to Canada
data.intro_description: Canada's immigration system prioritizes family reunification—and the family sponsorship program allows Canadian citizens and permanent residents to sponsor their spouse, partner, children, parents, or grandparents for permanent residence. At Velox Immigration, we support you through every step of the sponsorship process, making sure it's complete, compliant, and compassionate.
data.who_we_help_intro: You may be eligible for family sponsorship if you are:

who_we_help_items.description: A Canadian citizen or permanent resident looking to sponsor your spouse or partner
A parent or grandparent seeking to reunite with your children or grandchildren
A dependent child of a Canadian or permanent resident
A spouse or common-law partner applying for inland or overseas sponsorship

data.what_we_offer_intro: We assist with a wide range of sponsorship categories:

what_we_offer_items.title: Spouse/Common-Law/Conjugal Sponsorship
what_we_offer_items.description: We help Canadian citizens and PRs sponsor their spouse or partner, whether they're in Canada (inland sponsorship) or abroad (outland sponsorship). Our service includes application prep, relationship documentation guidance, and handling complex cases like previous marriages, lack of documentation, or cohabitation issues.

what_we_offer_items.title: Dependent Child Sponsorship
what_we_offer_items.description: We help parents bring their biological or adopted children to Canada as permanent residents. We guide you through custody documents, proof of dependency, and medical/identity paperwork.

what_we_offer_items.title: Parents & Grandparents Sponsorship (PGP)
what_we_offer_items.description: If you've been selected through the PGP lottery, we'll help you complete and submit a strong sponsorship and permanent residence application. We also assist with Super Visa applications for long-term visits when sponsorship isn't immediately available.

data.what_you_need_to_apply:
Each sponsorship case is different, but typical requirements include:

For the Sponsor:

  • Proof of Canadian citizenship or PR status
  • A signed sponsorship undertaking to support the family member
  • Proof of income (for PGP)
  • Completed sponsorship agreement and forms

For the Sponsored Person:

  • Valid passport
  • Medical exam and police certificates
  • Civil documents (e.g., marriage certificate, birth certificate)
  • Photos and documents proving the genuine nature of the relationship

We help you build a strong and well-documented application package that meets IRCC expectations.
data.how_we_work_intro: When you work with Velox Immigration, you get a streamlined, transparent process:

how_we_work_items.title: Eligibility & Relationship Assessment
how_we_work_items.description: We confirm that you meet all sponsorship and relationship requirements and advise on inland vs. outland processing.

how_we_work_items.title: Document Gathering & Review
how_we_work_items.description: We guide you on collecting relationship proofs, income documentation, and all supporting materials.

how_we_work_items.title: Application Preparation & Submission
how_we_work_items.description: We complete the required forms, draft a personalized relationship narrative (if needed), and submit your sponsorship package.

how_we_work_items.title: Ongoing File Monitoring
how_we_work_items.description: We assist with biometric appointments, medical exams, and any additional IRCC document requests until a final decision is reached.

faq_items.question: Can I sponsor my spouse if I'm living outside Canada?
faq_items.answer: Only if you are a Canadian citizen (not a permanent resident) and show intent to return once PR is granted.

faq_items.question: Can my spouse work while the inland sponsorship is in process?
faq_items.answer: Yes. Inland spousal applicants may apply for an open work permit while their sponsorship is being processed.

faq_items.question: What if I don't meet the income requirement for PGP?
faq_items.answer: You may be ineligible for PGP but can apply for a Super Visa, which allows long-term visits without the same income bar.

faq_items.question: Can I sponsor my siblings?
faq_items.answer: Generally, no. There are limited exceptions, such as orphaned siblings under 18, or if you have no other family in Canada.

faq_items.question: What will be the processing time?
faq_items.answer: Processing times vary by country of residence and case complexity. Check IRCC processing times for updates.
